aiVerification.summary: The draft incorrectly merges many unrelated validation sheets and changed factors into one broad review case, so it cannot be used as final evidence.
issues: Blocking: changedFactor is an over-broad aggregation of unrelated tests including bonding amount, coil supplier/origin, VP thickness, LED UC time, AWF dimension, jig repair, CMG/SMG height, yoke jig, and other process changes.
Blocking: baselineCondition and changedCondition are not coherent comparable conditions and mix normal/test labels from multiple independent sheets.
Blocking: many outcomes are assigned to the same changedFactorId even though they represent distinct primary changed factors.
Blocking: row-level grouping keys such as sheet/test title, date, machine, bonding amount, frame/yoke condition, jig condition, and dimension/spec are not preserved.
Blocking: some outcomes combine unrelated comparisons under one metric, for example LED UC timing with Frame+SP by-hand testing.
Blocking: outcome domains are unreliable; several function defect tables are labeled as measurement, and header-derived measurement statistics are not valid outcome evidence.
Blocking: several cited evidence rows are header rows or generic title rows rather than citeable changed-condition data rows.
Non-blocking: the workbook contains citeable changed-condition evidence, so the file should not be excluded.
correctionPlan: Split the draft into separate review cases or changed-factor groups by sheet/test title and primary changed factor.
For each group, define one clear baseline condition and one or more directly comparable changed conditions from the same table context.
Preserve date, machine, bonding amount, frame, yoke, jig, dimension/spec, and other secondary conditions as subgroup keys rather than merging them into the primary factor.
Remove unrelated sheets from each review case, especially comparisons that belong to LED UC time, coil Korea, VP thickness, AWF dimension, Sub 1 jig repair, CMG/SMG height, and bonding amount tests.
Use only citeable data rows for evidence and include the relevant title/header rows only as context if the final schema supports contextual citations.
Recalculate or restate judgements only after valid same-context comparisons are formed.
Remove invalid measurement statistics extracted from table headers or non-measurement function tables.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Evidence row citations are not sufficient as drafted because they are mixed across unrelated contexts and include non-data/header rows; citations must be narrowed to comparable data rows within each changed-factor group.
